text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they learn from unfair data. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups of people. Fairness means making sure AI treats everyone equally. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it carefully. Transparency is important too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means that governments, companies, and researchers must work together. They should create clear rules and check AI systems regularly. In this way, we can use AI to help society while reducing its risks.
